units: pixels, seconds; image x to the right, y down

camera.evidence: phase correlation of background between frames (vehicle-free regions / frames 64-71) gives shifts < 0.03 px; no pan, zoom or shake
camera.view: looking straight at the plane of motion (vehicle seen from directly above/below, top-down view); background is a cloud/sky image
camera.perspective_note: the vehicle has real 3D depth: its top surface (body texture) moves ~3.5% faster in pixels than its silhouette extremes (nose, black fins), i.e. parallax inside the object; silhouette length varies 970-1066 px with image position (see notes). Only one moving object, so one scale is used.
